# React

> > The official React documentation and community hub covering the component-based JavaScript library for building interactive user interfaces for web and native applications.

React is maintained by Meta and a global community of developers. The site includes comprehensive documentation, official blog updates, and information about React Conf events featuring speakers like Lauren Tan, Dan Abramov, and other core contributors.

## Key Topics

- React
- React Native
- React Server Components
- JSX syntax
- Component-based architecture
- UI library
- JavaScript framework
- Interactive UI
- Web development
- Meta
- React Conf
- Lauren Tan
- Dan Abramov
- Joe Savona
- React community

## Getting Started

- [React](https://react.dev): React homepage: library for web & native UI with component-based approach

## Blog & Updates

- [React Blog](https://react.dev/blog): Official React blog: updates, release notes, React Foundation & deprecations

## Events & Community

- [React Conf 2025](https://conf.react.dev): React Conf 2025 event page: Oct 7-8 in Henderson, NV with speakers & info

## Optional

- [React Conf 2024](https://conf2024.react.dev): React Conf 2024 archive: Meta & Callstack hosted 7th conf with talks
